xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4369: Optional Jev (TypeSafe System One) judgment client: config, key slot, cost, evals (off by default)

plan.title: Optional Jev (TypeSafe System One) judgment client: config, key slot, cost, evals (off by default)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: This is the single shared foundation for three already-split consumer issues (PAN-4371, PAN-4372, PAN-4373). Its surface spans config-yaml, the jev client, background-ai registry, pricing, Settings UI, evals and docs because each of those is one small, required seam of an off-by-default feature; every seam is its own vertical item here, and none is shippable as a sibling issue without leaving an unreachable or unconfigurable client.

narratives.Problem: Several Overdeck decisions are fuzzy judgments made with keyword lists or not made at all (is an agent's last message a question; is an acceptance criterion observable). TypeSafe's Jev model answers typed questions with calibrated probabilities in under 0.5 s at $0.042/Mtok input, but Overdeck has no client, config, key slot, cost accounting or eval harness for it. Research: .pan/drafts/jev-integration.md.
narratives.Proposal: Add an optional, off-by-default Jev client in src/lib/jev/ (config resolution with typed unavailable reasons, a content-addressed memo with in-flight dedupe and a concurrency cap of 4, and a never-throwing assess() that records cost through recordBackgroundAiCost). Configure it through a new jev: block and an api_keys.typesafe slot (with TYPESAFE_API_KEY fallback), gate it through three new background-ai features that default off, price jev-1.13 and jev-1.13-free, expose the toggles and a key input in Settings -> Background AI, add a smoke eval that skips when unconfigured, and document it in configuration/jev.mdx. The model comes only from jev.model; nothing in this issue calls assess() outside tests and the eval.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No call sites of assess() outside tests and the eval; turn-end, AC review and memory relevance consumers are PAN-4371, PAN-4372, PAN-4373
- No hardcoded model id or model fallback anywhere in src/lib/jev (no jev-latest, no TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL reliance)
- No new ModelProvider, PROVIDERS entry or model-picker entry for Jev
- No Settings editor for jev.model, jev.base_url or jev.timeout_ms (config.yaml only); the key input is the only new Settings control besides the toggles
- No startup check, doctor check, health check or warning when Jev is unconfigured
- No persistence of Jev verdicts (no DB rows, agent rows, journal or tracker writes); the memo is in-process only
- No Effect facade around the Promise client
- No edits to sync-sources/hooks/record-cost-event.js or src/lib/settings.ts
- No scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt edits
- No vendoring of the TypeSafe agent skill into sync-sources/skills/

autoDecisions.summary: assess() lives in src/lib/jev/client.ts next to createJevClient(); no index.ts barrel.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists client/config/questions/memo only; keeping assess in client.ts avoids an extra file and a barrel.

autoDecisions.summary: Config types and normalizer go in a new src/lib/config-yaml/jev.ts, and the merge lands in merge.ts (not only schema/defaults/load as the issue says).
autoDecisions.rationale: merge.ts is where every other block (ollama, registry, api_keys) is folded; ollama.ts is the established pattern for a small typed block.

autoDecisions.summary: schema.ts grows by exactly 4 lines using inline import('./jev.js') types and no comments.
autoDecisions.rationale: schema.ts is 1092 lines against an allowlist cap of 1096, and agents may not raise the cap; inline import types have precedent in verification-runner.ts and kimi-code.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate order: disabled -> not-configured -> model-not-configured -> no-api-key; added a 'no-api-key' reason the issue did not name.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the feature gate runs first; a missing key needs its own reason so the SDK constructor never throws on the normal path.

autoDecisions.summary: Memo key adds featureKey and a hash of the questions to the issue's (state hash, question-set version, model) key; only answered results are cached.
autoDecisions.rationale: Two consumers sending the same state with different question maps would otherwise share an entry, and caching a transient 429 would make it sticky.

autoDecisions.summary: SDK retries disabled (maxRetries 0); baseURL passed only when jev.base_url is set; logLevel forced to 'warn'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Callers schedule assessments off hot paths so fail-fast is correct; forcing warn overrides a TYPESAFE_LOG_LEVEL=debug env that would log bodies.

autoDecisions.summary: Toggle descriptions live in frontend Settings/types.ts BACKGROUND_AI_FEATURE_META (and identical strings in registry.ts); settingsPageConstants.ts only gains cost-source entries.
autoDecisions.rationale: That is where descriptions actually live today; the issue's file name refers to the Settings constants in general.

autoDecisions.summary: The TypeSafe key input lives in Settings -> Background AI, not the Providers section.
autoDecisions.rationale: There is no page named 'API Keys'; TypeSafe is not a model provider, and the key only serves the jev* background features.

autoDecisions.summary: Toggle descriptions name the data each future consumer will send, taken from the research PRD's consumer designs.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires descriptions naming the data sent while this issue itself sends nothing; the docs page states that explicitly.

autoDecisions.summary: The smoke eval takes model and key from config via resolveJevConfig, bypasses the feature toggle and cost recording, and uses evalite.skip with a printed reason when unconfigured.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says skip when no key; the no-hardcoded-model rule forbids an eval literal; operators run evals deliberately.

autoDecisions.summary: Invalid jev values throw at config load.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the registry.classification and ollama precedent in merge.ts; absence of the block remains silent.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 (exact code and line anchors there). Create src/lib/config-yaml/jev.ts (YamlJevConfig, NormalizedJevConfig {configured, baseUrl?, model?, apiKeyRef, timeoutMs}, DEFAULT_JEV_API_KEY_REF='TYPESAFE_API_KEY', DEFAULT_JEV_TIMEOUT_MS=2000, DEFAULT_NORMALIZED_JEV, normalizeJevConfig(raw, current)) following src/lib/config-yaml/ollama.ts; it imports nothing from src/lib/jev. null/undefined raw returns current; a mapping sets configured:true; invalid types or timeout_ms outside 1..30000 throw `config.yaml: jev.<key> ...`; blank model becomes undefined. schema.ts: add EXACTLY 4 lines, no comments: `typesafe?: string;` in YamlConfig.api_keys and in NormalizedConfig.apiKeys, `jev?: import('./jev.js').YamlJevConfig;` after `ollama?: YamlOllamaConfig;`, and `jev: import('./jev.js').NormalizedJevConfig;` after `ollama: NormalizedOllamaConfig;`. defaults.ts: `jev: { ...DEFAULT_NORMALIZED_JEV }`. merge.ts: init `jev: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.jev }`, fold `result.jev = normalizeJevConfig(config.jev, result.jev);` after the ollama fold, and `if (config.api_keys.typesafe) result.apiKeys.typesafe = resolveEnvVar(config.api_keys.typesafe);` after the voyage branch (no enabledProviders.add). load.ts applyEnvironmentFallbacks: TYPESAFE_API_KEY fallback after VOYAGE_API_KEY. Tests via mergeConfigs as listed in PRD WI-2.

items.title: Given `mergeConfigs(null)`, when the config is read, then `config.jev` equals `{ configured: false, apiKeyRef: 'TYPESAFE_API_KEY', timeoutMs: 2000 }` (test).

Given a `jev:` block with model, base_url and timeout_ms 1500, when merged, then `config.jev` returns configured true with those values; given `jev: {}`, then configured is true and model is undefined (test).
Given `jev: { timeout_ms: 0 }`, when merged, then mergeConfigs throws an error matching /jev.timeout_ms/ (test).
Given `api_keys: { typesafe: 'k' }`, when merged, then `config.apiKeys.typesafe` equals 'k' (test).
Given the finished change, when `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh` runs, then it exits 0 and `wc -l < src/lib/config-yaml/schema.ts` prints at most 1096.

Resolve Jev config and key with typed unavailable reasons in src/lib/jev/config.ts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 (config.ts block). Export JevFeature (Extract of the three jev keys), JevConfigInput = Pick<NormalizedConfig,'backgroundAi'|'jev'|'apiKeys'>, JevUnavailableReason = 'disabled'|'not-configured'|'model-not-configured'|'no-api-key', ResolvedJevConfig {apiKey, model, baseUrl?, timeoutMs}, resolveJevConfig(config, env = process.env) for steps 2-4, and resolveJevForFeature(feature, config, env?) that first checks isBackgroundFeatureEnabled(feature, config). Key = apiKeys.typesafe (trimmed, non-empty) else env[jev.apiKeyRef] (trimmed, non-empty) else 'no-api-key'. No model literal anywhere.

items.title: Given cheapMode true, when resolveJevForFeature runs, then it returns { ok: false, reason: 'disabled' } (test).

Given cheapMode false, the feature on and jev.configured false, when resolved, then it returns reason 'not-configured'; given configured true with no model, then 'model-not-configured'; given a model but no key anywhere, then 'no-api-key' (tests).

Given both apiKeys.typesafe and env[apiKeyRef] set, when resolved, then the result uses apiKeys.typesafe; given only a custom apiKeyRef 'MY_JEV_KEY' in the injected env, then the key comes from it (tests).
Add the Jev memo: content-addressed LRU, in-flight dedupe and a 4-request concurrency cap

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 (memo.ts block) and Decisions 9-10. Model on src/lib/agent-input-detection.ts (paneDetectionCache / paneDetectionInFlight / withPaneDetectionSlot). Export JEV_MEMO_MAX_ENTRIES=256, JEV_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS=4, jevMemoKey({featureKey, model, questionSetVersion, state, questions}) = `${featureKey}:${model}:${questionSetVersion}:${sha256(JSON.stringify({state, questions}))}`, getMemoized (LRU touch), setMemoized (evict oldest), dedupeInFlight(key, run), withJevSlot(run), resetJevMemo(). Header comment documents that a joined in-flight request inherits the first caller's signal and outcome.

items.title: Given 257 distinct keys set, when the first key is read, then getMemoized returns undefined, and a key touched by a read before overflow is preserved (test).
Given two concurrent dedupeInFlight calls with the same key, when both resolve, then `run` was invoked exactly once and both receive the same value (test).
Given five withJevSlot bodies that block on deferred promises, when they start, then only four run until one resolves (test).
Given two key inputs that differ only in questions or only in featureKey, when jevMemoKey runs, then it produces different keys (test).
Build createJevClient and the never-throwing assess() entry point with cost recording

expected_outputs: the grep finds no model id literal and the command exits 0

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 (questions.ts and client.ts blocks) and Decisions 1, 5-11. questions.ts: QUESTION_SET_VERSION = 1, JEV_SMOKE_QUESTIONS (one noul), JEV_SMOKE_NOUL_THRESHOLD = 0.5. client.ts: createJevClient(resolved, {fetch?}) builds TypeSafeClient with apiKey, defaultModel = resolved.model, baseURL only when set, logLevel 'warn', timeout = timeoutMs, retry { maxRetries: 0 }, fetch when given. assess(featureKey, state, questions, {signal?, config?, fetch?, env?}): resolve (config defaults to loadConfigSync().config) -> unavailable; memo hit -> return; else dedupeInFlight(key, () => withJevSlot(...)) calling systemOne({state, questions, model}) with {signal}, recording cost via recordBackgroundAiCost({feature, provider:'custom', model: result.model || resolved.model, usage:{inputTokens, outputTokens}}), caching only 'answered'. catch -> { status:'failed', reason: classifyJevError(err), message } using the instanceof order in PRD WI-4; never rethrow, never console-log the error. Tests: fake fetch through the SDK fetch option, inline configs with cheapMode false, vi.mock('../../costs/events.js') as in background-ai cost.test.ts, vi.useFakeTimers for the timeout case, vi.stubEnv for env cases.

items.title: Given cheap mode on, or no jev block, or jev.model unset with a key and TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL='jev-latest' stubbed, when assess() is called, then it returns unavailable with reason 'disabled', 'not-configured' or 'model-not-configured' respectively and the fake fetch is never invoked (tests).

Given jev.model 'test-model-x' and base_url 'https://opencode.ai/zen', when assess() sends a request, then the fetch URL is 'https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/systemone' and the request body model is 'test-model-x' (test).

Given the fake fetch returns 401, 429, or never settles until its signal aborts (fake timers advanced by timeoutMs), when assess() runs, then it resolves to failed with reason 'auth-failed', 'rate-limited' or 'timeout' and never rejects (tests).
Given the same state and questions sent twice sequentially, or twice concurrently, when assess() runs, then the fake fetch is called exactly once and both calls return answered (tests).

Given a successful response reporting model 'jev-1.13-free', when assess() completes, then exactly one cost event is appended with source 'background:jevTurnEndAssessment', provider 'custom' and cost 0, and a following memo hit appends none; given model 'jev-1.13' with 1,000,000 input tokens, the event cost is 0.042 (tests).

narrative.Action: PRD WI-8 and Decision 15. Fixture: 8 cases {name, state, asksQuestion} (4 true, 4 false), synthetic text only. Eval: resolution = resolveJevConfig(loadConfigSync().config); when not ok, console.warn('[jev-smoke] skipped: <reason>') and register via evalite.skip; else evalite. Task calls createJevClient(resolution.config).systemOne({state, questions: JEV_SMOKE_QUESTIONS, model: resolution.config.model}) and returns answers.asks_question.noul; scorer (createScorer) scores 1 when (noul >= JEV_SMOKE_NOUL_THRESHOLD) equals the label. Add the README table row and the one sentence from PRD WI-8.
